name: Sight LGD #2
description:
They say that beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
Beauty is subjective and it often makes me wonder,
What is it about sight that changes point of view?
There’s definitely some societal programming in there too.
But the eye sees and the heart wanders,
Truly touching,
How sight makes the heart grow fonder.
